# OrdinaryDiffEqOperatorSplitting.jl

## Features
* Adaptive timestepping
* Interpolation
* Callbacks
* Arbitrary splitting

## SciML design
* export `OperatorSplittingProblem`
* Tree of integrators
* Each integrator can operate on arbitrary subset of states
* support standard `init`/`solve`

## Solver flexibility
* solvers define a `perform_step!` and everything else comes free
